name: finra_short_interest_fetcher

name: options-dataset-hist
what_it_holds: README claims historical options data for SPY/IWM/QQQ, Jan 2008-Dec 2025, 53M+ contracts with Greeks/IV/microstructure, in SQLite (.db.zst) and partitioned Parquet. VERIFIED via gh api: repo is only 1886 KB total; data/spy_options.db.zst, iwm_options.db.zst, qqq_options.db.zst are each ~134-135 bytes (git-lfs pointer stubs, not real data); data/parquet_spy, parquet_iwm, parquet_qqq are empty (0-byte) directories; no GitHub releases with assets. The referenced upstream (github.com/philippdubach/historic-options-dataset) returns 404 (deleted/renamed). This looks like an unpopulated/placeholder or fork of a dead repo despite a convincing description.
why_useful: Would be a strong general options/IV methodology dataset (index ETF proxies for IV term structure and event-window construction) if real, but currently non-functional — no usable bytes behind the claim.
size_hint: repo 1.9MB total; data files are ~134-byte stubs; parquet dirs empty
themes: Options and event-move tooling: historical option chains (CBOE samples, ORATS-like), earnings implied-move calculators, IV term-structure datasets, earnings-drift datasets
why_all: Would be a strong general options/IV methodology dataset (index ETF proxies for IV term structure and event-window construction) if real, but currently non-functional — no usable bytes behind the claim.

name: options-data
what_it_holds: Described as a 'historical options data store for backtesting and analysis'; MIT licensed, updated 15 Jul 2026, 1 star. Not yet inspected for whether it commits actual chain data or is a scraper/ETL scaffold pointing at a paid feed (common pattern in this search).
why_useful: Possible general-purpose options-chain storage/ETL tool that could be pointed at ABNB's own option chain (we already pull current Yahoo chains) to build a rolling historical archive ourselves, which we do not currently have (our options data is 'current' only, not a time series).

name: BR-Fama-French-Factors
what_it_holds: Open database of Fama-French style factors constructed for the Brazilian equity market (fills the stated absence of official FF factors for Brazil).
why_useful: Could support a Brazil-specific equity risk model if the team ever builds a LatAm-listed comparator regression, but is a factor dataset, not travel/STR/consumer data, so relevance to ABNB LatAm nights/ADR forecasting is indirect.
